title: Data, materials, and analysis code for: Perceived Liberalism and Intellect Cannot Be Reduced to a Single Openness Dimension: A State-Trace Experiment
description: Anonymized data, study materials, and R analysis code accompanying the in-press Journal of Research in Personality article by Johannes Titz and Benedikt Gailer. Licensing varies by content: R code is GPL-3.0-or-later; original data, documentation, and study materials are CC BY 4.0; and underlying IPIP items and scales are public domain.
